WITH coupon_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ORIG_AIRPORT_CD, 
    DEST_AIRPORT_CD, 
    COUNT(*) AS coupon_count
  FROM prashanth_subrahmanyam_catalog.dev_prashanth_subrahmanyam_evcr_bronze.tkt_coupon
  WHERE ORIG_AIRPORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND DEST_AIRPORT_CD IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ORIG_AIRPORT_CD, DEST_AIRPORT_CD
), fare_basis_rank AS (
  SELECT 
    ORIG_AIRPORT_CD, 
    DEST_AIRPORT_CD, 
    FARE_BASIS_CD, 
    COUNT(*) AS fare_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORIG_AIRPORT_CD, DEST_AIRPORT_CD ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS fb_rank
  FROM prashanth_subrahmanyam_catalog.dev_prashanth_subrahmanyam_evcr_bronze.tkt_coupon

  SELECT 
    ORIG_AIRPORT_CD, 
    DEST_AIRPORT_CD, 
    coupon_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY coupon_count DESC) AS route_rank

  rr.ORIG_AIRPORT_CD, 
  rr.DEST_AIRPORT_CD, 
  rr.coupon_count, 
  fbr.FARE_BASIS_CD AS most_common_fare_basis
